name: lily
description: Lily：多内核（mihomo / sing-box / Xray）的桌面代理客户端，内置防 DNS / WebRTC / IPv6 泄露、订阅转换、多订阅同时使用和 VPS 管理
author: Lily

scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-core.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && node scripts/fetch-core.mjs --platform win32 --arch arm64 && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/fetch-core.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64 && node scripts/fetch-core.mjs --platform darwin --arch x64 && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/fetch-core.mjs --platform linux --arch x64 && node scripts/fetch-core.mjs --platform linux --arch arm64 && electron-builder --linux
